summary: Backend testing for Class Up · El Castillo. Created a full pytest suite (23 tests) covering health, auth guards, Emergent-Google session exchange rejection paths, /auth/me with seeded TEST_TOKEN_123, assessments (list/open/complete), tasks CRUD + cross-user isolation, grades CRUD + summary, study sessions + summary, resources (public, >=20 items and Matemáticas filter), progress aggregation, and /auth/logout invalidation. 23/23 passed (100%). No _id leakage detected in any response body. Auth returns 401 (not 403) on missing/invalid Bearer tokens as required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 535 lines and starts to feel monolithic — consider splitting per-domain routers (auth/tasks/grades/sessions/resources/progress) into their own modules for maintainability, but not urgent.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI in favour of a lifespan context manager. Works today but will warn on newer FastAPI versions.

Every /api/auth/session call currently inserts a new row into user_sessions even if the same token exists (no upsert). The unique index on session_token would 409 on duplicate — Emergent tokens are unique per exchange, so this is safe today but an upsert would be more defensive.

PATCH /api/tasks rejects `completed: false` because the update filter uses `if v is not None` yet `model_dump()` returns None for unset fields, so this actually works — but the `if not updates: raise 400` branch could also reject valid partial updates that only set a boolean False. Verified end-to-end: toggling completed works. No fix needed, just noting.
seed_data_creation: Reused pre-seeded user_id=user_test123 / session_token=TEST_TOKEN_123. Additionally upserted a secondary user (user_test_secondary / TEST_TOKEN_SECONDARY) for cross-user isolation tests, and a TEST_TOKEN_LOGOUT session used exclusively by the logout test so it does not clobber the primary token used by parallel xdist workers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini in /app/backend forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. Any test class that mutates shared MongoDB state across the primary TEST_TOKEN_123 session must be careful — the logout test therefore uses its own dedicated TEST_TOKEN_LOGOUT so the primary token remains valid for other parallel workers. Seeded resources count is 22 (>=20 required). BASE_URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (=https://study-castle.preview.emergentagent.com).
